an5.165:1.1: Tatra kho āyasmā Sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi . . . pe . . . 2. Yo hi koci āvuso paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati, sabbo so pañcahi ṭhānehi etesaṃ vā aññatarena.
an5.165:1.3: Mandattā momūhattā paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati, pāpiccho icchāpakato paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati, paribhavaṃ paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati, aññātukāmo paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati, atha vā pakuppanto paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati
an5.165:1.4: ‘sace me pañhaṃ puṭṭho samma-d-eva vyākarissati, icc'etaṃ kusalaṃ, no ce me pañhaṃ puṭṭho samma-d-eva vyākarissati, aham assa samma-d-eva vyākarissāmī' ti.
an5.165:1.5: Yo hi koci āvuso paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati, sabbo so imehi pañcahi ṭhānehi etesaṃ vā aññatarena.
an5.165:1.6: Ahaṃ kho panāvuso evaṃcitto paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchāmi
an5.165:1.7: ‘sace me pañhaṃ puṭṭho samma-d-eva vyākarissati, icc'etaṃ kusalaṃ, no ce me pañhaṃ puṭṭho samma-d-eva vyākarissati, aham assa samma-d-eva vyākarissāmī
